evidence: commit 1b3cc90 -- Task 13 (F9 closed: diagnosticSettings routed to LAW; Entra diagnostics moved to a documented G0 human step)
assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13): platform/main.bicep routes diagnosticSettings for Key Vault (AuditEvent -- the estate's only real credentials), the cost-export storage account (account-level metrics and blob-service-level data-plane logs), the SQL database (Microsoft.Sql/servers/databases, not the server resource -- verified against the avm/res/sql/server@0.22.0 module schema, which has no top-level diagnosticSettings param) and the Container Apps environment, all to the Log Analytics workspace. SQL auditSettings sets isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled: true, so the previously-nominal audit (state: Enabled, no destination) actually writes somewhere. layer-06-platform.yml routes the subscription Activity Log (Administrative/Security/Policy/etc.) to the same workspace, relocated there from the brief's named layer-02-landing-zone.yml because on a full infra-up.yml pass L2 precedes L6, so the workspace the setting must reference does not exist yet at that point (a same-pass invariant, not universal -- infra-up.yml also supports a skip-tolerant selective replay). Entra ID SignInLogs/AuditLogs routing went through three rounds: first deferred as unverifiable without a live tenant; then implemented as an automated call in layer-06-platform.yml after review found the Microsoft.aadiam resource shape and required Security Administrator role are both publicly documented; then REMOVED from that workflow on further review, because Security Administrator is materially more standing tenant privilege than mls-github-deployer should hold -- Task 10 narrowed this exact SP's Graph permission specifically to shrink its blast radius (finding F8), and granting it Security Administrator now would re-inflate precisely what that narrowing closed. The remedy that landed is a documented human step instead: docs/runbooks/g0-bootstrap.md Section C item 12 carries the exact az monitor diagnostic-settings create command, states the Security Administrator/Global Administrator requirement, and states it runs after L6. This is the same standard item 4 (the Fabric SP API toggle) already meets for a different tenant-level, one-time, no-pipeline-identity setting -- a documented human step with an exact command is a remedy, not a deferral. A prior pass also downgraded this control's gapSeverity from high to medium reasoning that most of F9's items had landed; that was reverted on review, citing 3.1.5.json's own precedent (F13 five-of-seven landed, severity held at high) -- severity does not discount for partial progress. With every piece of F9 now remedied -- in IaC or in the G0 runbook -- this control closes outright. Checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.3.1.

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. A regression here -- diagnosticSettings removed from any of Key Vault/storage/SQL/CAE, SQL auditSettings losing isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled, the subscription Activity Log dropped from layer-06-platform.yml, Security Administrator granted to mls-github-deployer to re-automate the Entra step, or G0 runbook item 12 deleted without replacement -- would reopen it.
